WITH player_doubles AS (
  SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.bats,
    AVG(bp.double) as avg_doubles
  FROM batting_postseason bp
  JOIN player p ON bp.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE bp.double IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats
),
grand_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) as grand_mean
  FROM player_doubles
),
player_index AS (
  SELECT 
    pd.player_id,
    pd.bats,
    pd.avg_doubles,
    pd.avg_doubles / ga.grand_mean as index_value
  FROM player_doubles pd
  CROSS JOIN grand_avg ga
),
hand_avg_index AS (
  SELECT 
    bats,
    AVG(index_value) as hand_avg_index
  FROM player_index
  GROUP BY bats
),
player_gap AS (
  SELECT 
    pi.player_id,
    pi.bats,
    pi.avg_doubles,
    pi.index_value,
    pi.index_value - hai.hand_avg_index as gap
  FROM player_index pi
  JOIN hand_avg_index hai ON pi.bats = hai.bats
)
SELECT 
  player_id,
  bats as batting_hand,
  avg_doubles,
  index_value as index,
  gap
FROM player_gap
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Postseason batting records with NULL values in the double column are excluded from each player's average calculation
A player's batting hand is sourced from the player table (bats column) and is assumed constant across all their postseason records
